title: Upload

phoneHint: Leave empty for a hidden number.

recordingFailed: The call is uploaded. Its recording wasn't backed up.
txOff: Transcription is off. Add a transcript file to upload this call.
unsupported: This file type isn't supported. Use audio, or TXT, SRT, VTT or JSON transcripts.

flow.managed: Audio passes through AskCalls to {provider}, streamed and not stored. {provider} may keep request logs under its standard policy.
flow.direct: Audio goes from your device straight to {provider} under your account. AskCalls doesn't see it.

reason.audio_unreadable: Couldn't decode the audio. The file may be damaged or in an unsupported format.
reason.transcript_unreadable: Couldn't read the transcript. Use TXT, SRT, VTT or JSON.
reason.transcription_unavailable: Transcription is off. Add a transcript file to upload this call.
reason.provider_key_rejected: The transcription provider rejected the key. Check it in Settings → Providers.
reason.provider_permission: The transcription key lacks the speech-to-text permission. Enable it in your provider key settings.
reason.provider_zero_retention: Zero retention needs an ElevenLabs Enterprise plan. Turn it off in Settings → Providers.
reason.quota: A plan limit was reached. Check your usage in Settings.
reason.quotaMinutes: Transcription limit reached for this month. Upload the transcript instead, or use your own key.
reason.quotaCalls: Call limit reached. Delete calls to upload more.
reason.rate_limited: Too many uploads at once. Retry in a minute.
reason.locked: AskCalls locked during the upload. Retry.
reason.unauthorized: You were signed out. Sign in again and retry.
reason.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check your connection and retry.
reason.indexing_failed: Indexing failed on this device. Retry.
reason.unknown: This file couldn't be uploaded. Retry.

guide.title: Folder layout and manifest.csv
guide.pairing: A recording and a transcript with the same name in the same folder are one call. The transcript name may end in .transcript or _tx.
guide.manifest: manifest.csv is optional and sets each call's number, date, direction, contact and tags. Only the file column is required.

flowTr.managed: Calls your translation rules cover are also translated as they upload: the transcript passes through AskCalls to {provider}, streamed and not stored. No prompt each time; change the rules in Settings → Providers.
flowTr.direct: Calls your translation rules cover are also translated as they upload: the transcript goes from your device straight to {provider} under your account. No prompt each time; change the rules in Settings → Providers.
flowTr.off: No translation rules: calls are kept in their own language only.
